lex:
ἀδικέω, -ῶ
(ἄδικος), [in LXX for עשׁק, עוה, etc. ;]
__1. intrans., to be ἄδικος, do wrong, act wickedly or criminally: Act.25:11, 1Co.6:8, 2Co.7:12, Col.3:25, Rev.22:11; to do hurt, Rev.9:19.
__2. Trans.
__(a) to do some wrong: ὃ ἠδίκησεν, Col.3:25; to wrong some one, Mat.20:13, Act.7:26, 27 25:10, 2Co.7:2, Gal.4:12, Phm 18, 2Pe.2:13; pass., Act.7:24, 2Co.7:12; mid., 1Co.6:7 (suffer . . . to be wronged; WM, §38, 3; but see Bl., §54, 5; and cf. ἀποστερέω);
__(b) to injure, hurt: Luk.10:19 Rev.2:11 6:6 7:2, 3 9:4,10 11:5.
†

strongs.def: to be unjust, i.e. (actively) do wrong (morally, socially or physically)
strongs.kjv: hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer, take) wrong
